# AllShoeSizeConverter

> Free shoe size converter and international footwear conversion charts covering US, UK, EU, India, Japan, CM, and Mondopoint sizing for men, women, and kids.

AllShoeSizeConverter is an authoritative footwear sizing utility providing verified conversion tables, foot measurement calculators, brand fitting guides, and age-based children's charts.

## Core Tools & Converters

- [Shoe Size Converter Homepage](https://allshoesizeconverter.com/): Interactive shoe size converter across US, UK, EU, India, Japan, CM, and inches.
- [All Shoe Size Converters Hub](https://allshoesizeconverter.com/converters/): Complete directory of 15+ specialized pair conversion tools.
- [US to EU Shoe Size Converter](https://allshoesizeconverter.com/us-to-eu-shoe-size/): Complete US to EU shoe size conversion chart and calculator.
- [US to UK Shoe Size Converter](https://allshoesizeconverter.com/us-to-uk-shoe-size/): Convert US men's, women's, and kids shoe sizes to UK sizes.
- [US to India Shoe Size Converter](https://allshoesizeconverter.com/us-to-india-shoe-size/): Conversion chart between US and Indian standard shoe sizes.
- [US to Japan Shoe Size Converter](https://allshoesizeconverter.com/us-to-japan-shoe-size/): Convert US shoe sizes to Japanese centimeter sizes.
- [EU to US Shoe Size Converter](https://allshoesizeconverter.com/eu-to-us-shoe-size/): Convert European shoe sizes to US men and women standards.
- [UK to US Shoe Size Converter](https://allshoesizeconverter.com/uk-to-us-shoe-size/): British to US footwear size conversion guide.
- [Find My Shoe Size by Foot Length](https://allshoesizeconverter.com/shoe-size-by-foot-length/): Interactive calculator to find shoe size from foot length in cm or inches.
- [Kids Shoe Size by Age Chart](https://allshoesizeconverter.com/kids-shoe-size-by-age/): Children's shoe size guide from newborn baby to 12-year-old youth.
- [Mondopoint Shoe Size Guide](https://allshoesizeconverter.com/mondopoint-shoe-size/): Millimeter sizing standard for ski boots and technical footwear.

## Regional Size Guides

- [All Countries Sizing Hub](https://allshoesizeconverter.com/country/): Comprehensive international footwear sizing standards by region.
- [US Shoe Size Chart](https://allshoesizeconverter.com/country/us/): Detailed United States footwear sizing standards and width fittings.
- [UK Shoe Size Chart](https://allshoesizeconverter.com/country/uk/): British footwear sizing standards and width letters.
- [EU Shoe Size Chart](https://allshoesizeconverter.com/country/europe/): European Paris Point shoe sizing standards.
- [India Shoe Size Chart](https://allshoesizeconverter.com/country/india/): Indian standard shoe sizes and width guidance.
